description: This class handles the disbursement command for GLIM loans in the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Spring service, and uses dependency injection to invoke the disbursement logic in LoanWritePlatformService.

classes.name: GlimLoanApplicationDisburseCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles GLIM loan disbursement commands, processes command by invoking the loan write platform service to perform the disbursement.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a disbursement command for a GLIM loan by delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService.
